an3.47:1.1: Tīṇ' imāni bhikkhave saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇāni. Katamāni tīṇi? Uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati. Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇānī ti. Tīṇ' imāni
an3.47:2.0: bhikkhave asaṅkhatassa asaṅkhatalakkhaṇāni. Katamāni tīṇi? Na uppādo paññāyati na vayo paññāyati na ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati. Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi asaṅkhatassa asaṅkhatalakkhaṇānī ti. Himavantaṃ
